title: Sources: Verizon is in talks to buy fiber-optic broadband operator Fidium for ~$6B, as part of its goal to expand its network to 50M US homes and businesses (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Verizon is in talks to buy fiber-optic broadband operator Fidium for ~$6B, as part of its goal to expand its network to 50M US homes and businesses — US group pursues company owned by Searchlight Capital and Canada's BCI in push to boost its presence in New England region
